name: cc0/padded_chair
credit: From SchoolChair_01 by Ethan Place, Poly Haven (CC0): shell replaced by a padded seat and back, frame darkened
_comment: The chair in the "Infinite house" frame 1: a white padded back and seat, dark legs. Poly Haven's school chair keeps its steel frame (legs and the two back rails); its slotted shell (every part that doesn't reach the floor) is dropped for two vinyl pads. Model space: inches, front towards -y.
